rows.title: OET Reading
rows.question: How are marks shared across OET Reading?
rows.text: OET's own page: Reading has 42 marks in all: 20 in Part A, 6 in Part B and 16 in Part C.

rows.title: OET Reading
rows.question: Where do I write my answers in OET Reading?
rows.text: OET's own page: in Part A you write your answers in the spaces in the question booklet; in Parts B and C you shade the circle beside your answer. Answers written anywhere else are not marked.

rows.title: OET Reading
rows.question: Do spelling mistakes lose marks in OET Reading?
rows.text: OET's own page: yes. An answer that is not spelled correctly gets no marks in Reading; American and British spellings are both accepted.

rows.title: OET Reading
rows.question: Is there extra time to check answers in OET Reading?
rows.text: OET's own page: no extra time is given at the end. Part A is collected after 15 minutes, so its answers cannot be checked later in the test.

rows.title: OET Writing
rows.question: How long is OET Writing, and what is the task?
rows.text: OET's own page: Writing takes 45 minutes: a formal letter on a matter of your own profession, written from case notes.

rows.title: OET Writing
rows.question: How is OET Writing marked?
rows.text: OET's own page: two OET assessors mark your letter against the official OET Writing criteria, six in all.

rows.title: OET Writing
rows.question: What happens if my OET letter is too long or too short?
rows.text: OET's own page: there is no automatic penalty for going outside the 180–200 word range, but a letter much longer or shorter usually shows weaknesses that the six criteria scores reflect.

rows.title: OET Writing
rows.question: Do spelling mistakes count in OET Writing?
rows.text: OET's own page: yes. Spelling is part of Language, one of the six Writing criteria, so spelling mistakes are taken into account in your Language score.

rows.title: OET Speaking
rows.question: How long is OET Speaking?
rows.text: OET's own page: about 20 minutes, with two role-plays of about 5 minutes each, specific to your profession.

rows.title: OET Speaking
rows.question: How is OET Speaking assessed?
rows.text: OET's own page: the Speaking sub-test is recorded, and two OET assessors mark the recording using the official Linguistic and Clinical Communication criteria.

rows.title: OET Speaking
rows.question: Can I write on the OET role-play card?
rows.text: OET's own page: yes, you may make notes on the role-play card and look at it at any time during the role-play; you give it back to the interlocutor at the end.

rows.title: OET Speaking
rows.question: What if I do not finish the OET role-play?
rows.text: OET's own page: there is no penalty for not covering every element on the role card; a role-play usually ends at about 5 minutes, and the interlocutor signals when to finish.

rows.title: Online OET
rows.question: In which ways can I take OET?
rows.text: OET's own page: in three ways: OET Test on Paper at a test centre, OET Test on Computer, and OET@Home on your own computer.

rows.title: Online OET
rows.question: Can I take OET at home?
rows.text: OET's own page: yes. OET@Home lets you take the OET Test remotely on your own computer.

rows.title: Online OET
rows.question: How fast are the results of OET on Computer and OET@Home?
rows.text: OET's own page: results are typically available within 6 days for the OET Test on Computer and OET@Home, and within 12 days for the OET Test on Paper.

rows.title: Online OET
rows.question: Are there practice tests for OET on Computer and OET@Home?
rows.text: OET's own page: yes. Free interactive sample tests for all four sub-tests are available for OET Test on Computer and OET@Home.

rows.title: OET Preparation Material
rows.question: Where can I find official OET sample tests?
rows.text: OET's own page: OET's free library of sample tests covers all four sub-tests, for OET Test on Paper and for OET Test on Computer / OET@Home.

rows.title: OET Preparation Material
rows.question: How often should I take an OET sample test?
rows.text: OET's own page: about one practice test every 2–3 weeks, working in between on the skills that caused your mistakes in the last one.

rows.title: OET Preparation Material
rows.question: Where should I begin preparing for OET?
rows.text: OET's own page: start with OET's free 'Intro to OET' online course, then use the OET Study Guide.

rows.title: OET Preparation Material
rows.question: Which OET preparation materials should I use?
rows.text: OET's own page: the materials on OET's own website and in the OET Store; it warns that unofficial materials from the internet often do not reflect the real test.

rows.title: OET Preparation Material
rows.question: How can I check my English level before OET?
rows.text: OET's own page: OET Pulse, a 30-minute check of reading, listening and language knowledge for healthcare professionals, gives your current English level.

rows.title: OET for Occupational Therapists in the United States
rows.question: Do occupational therapists need an English test for a US work visa?
rows.text: In the United States, an occupational therapist trained abroad needs a VisaScreen certificate from TruMerit before an occupational visa; it includes passing an English language proficiency exam, unless your professional education was in English (TruMerit names this exemption), and TruMerit names OET among the approved exams (not the at-home versions). The minimum score depends on the profession.
